metadata.scenario: A prospect calls to ask about the different types of physical therapy services offered and their benefits. Category: New Inquiry. Customer type: prospect.

transcription.text: Thank you for calling CareFirst Home Health, this is Margaret speaking. How can I help you today? Hi, Margaret. My name is Edward Martinez, and I’m looking for information on your physical therapy services. Hi, Edward! I’d be happy to help you with that. What specific information are you looking for? I want to know the types of physical therapy services you offer and what their benefits are. Absolutely! We provide several types of physical therapy, including post-surgery rehabilitation and mobility training. Okay, can you tell me more about post-surgery rehabilitation? Certainly! This service focuses on helping clients regain strength and mobility after a surgical procedure. It usually lasts 45 to 60 minutes per session and costs between $110 and $140. That sounds beneficial. And what about mobility training? Mobility training helps improve balance and walking techniques. It's particularly useful for recovery after a stroke or surgery. Those sessions also last 45 to 60 minutes and are in the same price range. Great! I think my wife might need some sessions too, she has some issues with mobility. I'm glad to hear that! We can definitely set up an appointment for her as well. Would you recommend starting with an assessment first? Yes, an initial assessment is a great way to tailor the therapy to her specific needs. How soon could that assessment be scheduled? We typically have availability within a week. Would you like me to check specific dates? Yes, please! That would be helpful. Alright, let me take your information and I'll coordinate that for you. My number is +13165553690. Thank you, Edward! And could I also get the best times for you to receive a call? Any time in the afternoon works best for me. Perfect! I’ll follow up later today with available times for the assessment. Sounds great! I appreciate your help. You’re welcome! One last thing, I can also send you information on our other services if you're interested. Yes, please do that. It would be helpful to see what else you offer. I’ll make sure you receive that information. Thank you for calling, Edward! Thank you, Margaret. I’m looking forward to your call. Have a great day! Goodbye! Goodbye!
